==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:; (Appears after completing [[Daybreak at Last]])
:'''Lingyan:''' Hi, {{Rover}}! Fancy seeing you again!
:'''Lingyan:''' Thank you so much for your help that day.
:{{DIcon}} You're welcome.
:'''Lingyan:''' I'll forever cherish the memories of that race. I got to have you and [[Jiyan|our general]] as my teammates!
:'''Lingyan:''' I heard you and the general tackled a big problem together.
:'''Lingyan:''' Man, I hope to be as capable as you someday!
:{{DIcon}} You are already quite capable.
:'''Lingyan:''' Thank you for saying that! I've always wanted to serve on the front lines, but I was assigned to the [[Rearguard Base]]. Guess I'll just have to stay here for now.
:'''Lingyan:''' I don't want to give up my dream yet, so I'm still trying to apply for a transfer.
:{{DIcon}} The front line is dangerous.
:'''Lingyan:''' I know, but somebody's gotta be out there for our people. I won't regret my choice, no matter what happens.
:'''Lingyan:''' And before that, I'll be giving my all to protect people as a Rearguard!
:'''Lingyan:''' Duty calls. I should return to my post now. See ya around!
{{Dialogue End}}
